questions.q: Why did Gulliver go to Cambridge?
questions.explain: He did this to prepare himself for future travels.

questions.q: What did Gulliver do after leaving Mr. Bates and his uncle's help?
choices: went back to his father's estate
questions.explain: He studied medicine to be useful in long voyages.

questions.q: Which of the following was not part of Gulliver's preparations for travel?
choices: being made a prisoner in Lilliput
joining the navy to find a ship
questions.explain: This was an unexpected event during his travels, not part of his preparations.

questions.q: Why was Gulliver unable to finish his studies in Cambridge?
questions.explain: Gulliver's father needed money to support all his sons, making it difficult for Gulliver to maintain his allowance.

questions.q: What was Gulliver's first intention to travel according to the story?
choices: To earn a living as a surgeon
To get away from his family
To visit the country of Lilliput
questions.explain: Gulliver believed he would use his learning in navigation and mathematics for future travel.

questions.q: How did Gulliver's father assist him after he left Mr. Bates?
choices: Sent him to study in Leyden
Sent him to work as a surgeon
questions.explain: Gulliver's father and his uncle John provided him with money and a promise of yearly maintenance.
